t: A free spreadsheet program for data tables, formulas, and charts.
steps: Download the LibreOffice suite from libreoffice.org.
Ask IT to install it on school computers. Managed devices need install rights.
Open Calc and enter a small table of numbers.
Write one formula to add a column.
Select the table and insert a chart.
Save a test file and reopen it.
Chromebook users can try the Collabora ChromeOS or Android app. The research did not review it.
